name: How do you ensure a shower tile installation is waterproof?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure a shower tile installation is waterproof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensuring a shower tile installation is waterproof involves a multi-layered approach. First, the substrate (typically cement board) is properly installed and sealed at seams. Next, a continuous waterproofing membrane, either liquid-applied or sheet-based, is installed over the entire shower area. This membrane acts as a barrier to prevent water from reaching the wall structure. Additionally, proper sloping of the shower pan towards the drain, sealed corners, and correct installation of the drain itself are critical. These steps, when performed correctly, create a fully sealed and waterproof enclosure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproofing involves installing a waterproof substrate, applying a continuous waterproofing membrane, ensuring proper shower pan slope, and sealing all corners and the drain correctly.
